165:   /** spawn → initialize (retries bounded by ONE total deadline; C-001). */
166:   async ready(timeoutMs) {
167:     if (this.state === 'READY') return this.initializeElapsedMs ?? 0
168:     const budgetMs = timeoutMs ?? this.deadlines.initializeTimeoutMs
169:     if (this.state === 'SPAWNING') this.transition('INITIALIZING')
170:     // Deadline starts at the INITIALIZING transition, before the first
171:     // initialize write; retries never reset it.
172:     const initDeadlineMono = monotonicNowMs() + budgetMs
173:     const startedWall = Date.now()
174:     for (;;) {
175:       if (this.exit !== undefined) {

177:           ? Object.assign(new Error(`spawn failed without child for agent ${this.agentId}: ${this.spawnFailure.error}`), { code: 'AGENT_PROCESS_SPAWN_FAILED' })
178:           : Object.assign(new Error(`initialize failed for agent ${this.agentId}: child exited (${this.exit.code ?? 'signal'})`), { code: 'AGENT_PROCESS_EXITED' })
179:       }
180:       if (monotonicNowMs() >= initDeadlineMono) {
181:         void this.fatal('initialize_timeout')
